notes: Rung 4 (content hash). The same subagent event arrives live and file with NO NativeID/UUID/ToolUseID, so identity falls to the content hash. CRITICAL: both copies carry the IDENTICAL native timestamp — Event.ID() folds Timestamp.UnixNano() into the hash, so a mismatched timestamp would give two distinct ids and defeat the collapse. Both admitted (subagent), collapse to one. First admitted copy (live) wins.
